# usefulapi

Hosted [MCP](https://modelcontextprotocol.io) servers for the tools you already use — connect
from Claude, Cursor, or any MCP client. No local install, no key-juggling: authorize once and go.

**Portal:** https://usefulapi.io

_More servers land here as they launch — each is a folder with its own README + `server.json`,
and a tile on the [portal](https://usefulapi.io)._

## What's in each folder

- `README.md` — what the server does, tools, pricing, the "Add to Claude" snippet
- `server.json` — the [official MCP Registry](https://registry.modelcontextprotocol.io) record
  (namespace `io.usefulapi/*`), pointing at the hosted endpoint

toolsPreview.name: portkey_get_analytics_graph
toolsPreview.description: Get a time-series analytics graph for a single metric (cost, requests, tokens, latency, error-rate, cache-hit-rate, …) over a time window. Optionally scope by virtual keys, configs, or metadata. Portkey: GET /analytics/graphs/{metric}.

toolsPreview.name: portkey_get_analytics_group
toolsPreview.description: Get grouped analytics (aggregated by models, users, or metadata) over a time window. Portkey: GET /analytics/groups/{group}.

toolsPreview.name: portkey_list_configs
toolsPreview.description: List gateway configs (routing/fallback/retry/cache rulesets applied to requests). Portkey: GET /configs.

toolsPreview.name: portkey_get_config
toolsPreview.description: Get a single gateway config by slug (or id), including its routing rules. Portkey: GET /configs/{slug}.

toolsPreview.name: portkey_list_api_keys
toolsPreview.description: List API keys in the organization/workspace (metadata only — secrets are never returned). Portkey: GET /api-keys.

toolsPreview.name: portkey_get_api_key
toolsPreview.description: Get a single API key's metadata by id (the secret is never returned). Portkey: GET /api-keys/{id}.

toolsPreview.name: portkey_list_virtual_keys
toolsPreview.description: List virtual keys (the aliases that map to provider credentials + budget/rate limits used in requests). Portkey: GET /virtual-keys.

toolsPreview.name: portkey_get_virtual_key
toolsPreview.description: Get a single virtual key by slug, including its provider + limits. Portkey: GET /virtual-keys/{slug}.

toolsPreview.name: portkey_list_workspaces
toolsPreview.description: List workspaces in the organization. Portkey: GET /workspaces.

toolsPreview.name: portkey_get_workspace
toolsPreview.description: Get a single workspace by slug/id. Portkey: GET /workspaces/{id}.

toolsPreview.name: portkey_list_workspace_members
toolsPreview.description: List members of a workspace (users + their roles). Portkey: GET /workspaces/{id}/members.

toolsPreview.name: portkey_list_users
toolsPreview.description: List users in the organization. Filter by role or email. Portkey: GET /users.

toolsPreview.name: portkey_get_user
toolsPreview.description: Get a single user by id. Portkey: GET /users/{id}.

toolsPreview.name: portkey_list_user_invites
toolsPreview.description: List pending user invitations to the organization. Portkey: GET /user-invites.

toolsPreview.name: portkey_list_audit_logs
toolsPreview.description: List audit log entries (admin actions across the organization). Portkey: GET /audit-logs.

toolsPreview.name: portkey_create_feedback
toolsPreview.description: WRITES a feedback record into the Portkey account, attached to a request/trace by trace_id. Use for logging a quality score (typically -10..10) with an optional weight (0..1) and metadata. Portkey: POST /feedback.
